# nodes / stopall

<!-- Generated by @virtbase/proxmox-api-generator. Do not edit. -->

1 operation.

### `POST /nodes/{node}/stopall`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).stopall.$post()
```

Stop all VMs and Containers.

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `force-stop` | boolean |  | Force a hard-stop after the timeout. — default `1` |
| `max-workers` | number |  | Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. If  not set, uses 'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg, and if that's not set, the available CPU threads, clamped to a maximum of 8, are used. — min 1, max 64 |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `timeout` | number |  | Timeout for each guest shutdown task. Depending on `force-stop`, the shutdown gets then simply aborted or a hard-stop is forced. — min 0, max 7200, default `180` |
| `vms` | string |  | Only consider Guests with these IDs. — format `pve-vmid-list` |
